name: Keel Desktop

windows.name: Windows x64 (64-bit)
windows.notes: Built and checksummed by CI run 44527352992 and install-tested on Windows 11 (silent install, launch, bridge on 127.0.0.1, reinstall, silent uninstall, ~/.keel preserved). Not publicly hosted, so there is nothing to download yet. Unsigned - expect SmartScreen.
windows.installation: Run Keel-Setup-0.1.0.exe. Accept the installer prompts. Launch from the Start Menu shortcut or Desktop shortcut.

macos.name: macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon)
macos.notes: Built and checksummed by CI run 44527352992; the app bundle was inspected but the DMG was never mounted on a Mac. Not publicly hosted, so there is nothing to download yet. Unsigned - Gatekeeper will block. Intel Macs are not supported by this build.
macos.installation: Open the DMG, drag Keel into Applications, then right-click Keel and choose Open the first time (Gatekeeper).

linux.name: Linux x86_64
linux.notes: Built and checksummed by CI run 44527352992; AppImage and .deb were structure-inspected but not launched on desktop Linux. Not publicly hosted, so there is nothing to download yet. Unsigned; your distribution may show a policy warning.
linux.installation: Make the AppImage executable and run it. On Debian/Ubuntu the .deb can be installed with your package manager instead.

__hosting__: No public release has been published. The release workflow uploads installers to Keel-controlled R2 and publishes this manifest only after every file was downloaded over public HTTPS and matched against its SHA-256. Until then every channel stays unavailable. See docs/HOSTING.md.
